items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: I picked up one of my brother's piano players called "Hollywood" McCoy

ctx.x: '35...I'm going too far...'35 they sent for me to come up in Idaho and bring a band, and I had to get a band together, and I went up there, and I picked up one of my brother's piano players called "Hollywood" McCoy, the first colored boy I think born in Hollywood, 1912 or '13, and we went up there in '35, and we made such a hit with it we just had a...I just had a bunch of musicians, and they all were pretty good jazz merchants, you know, and we just called anything they'd play it whether they had music or not,…
